description: This file contains utility functions for determining command chaining operators based on the user's shell, and generating rules and notes for executing commands in different shell environments. It also includes project-specific rules and confidentiality guidelines.

methods.name: getCommandChainOperator
methods.description: Returns the command chaining operator based on the user's shell environment.

methods.name: getCommandChainNote
methods.description: Provides a note about command chaining syntax and platform-specific utilities.

methods.name: getRulesSection
methods.description: Generates a rules section string with project directory, command execution guidelines, and confidentiality notes.
